_description: PostgreSQL: data bind, a real /dev/shm (the OCI default 64 MB is too small), and a TCP health check on 5432.
_comment: A RECIPE: `uxc deploy postgres` pulls the server, creates /srv/postgres with the right owner, seeds a 0600 environment file and registers the bind + a TCP health check. The password is NOT set for you - edit /srv/postgres/env and uncomment POSTGRES_PASSWORD before the first start. A shared recipe must not ship a database password, and a placeholder people forget to change is worse than a container that refuses to start.

_source._comment_image: Major-version tag: a PostgreSQL major upgrade needs pg_upgrade or a dump/restore, so it must never happen unattended. check_updates follows 17 for patch releases; moving to 18 is a deliberate edit of this recipe (and a dump first).

_comment_paths: The alpine image runs the server as uid/gid 70. Creating the data dir with that owner avoids the first-start chown and makes a restored backup work straight away.
_comment_seed: 0600, and read at launch via env_file - so the password lives in one file next to the data instead of in the shared registry entry or in this profile.

content: # Environment for the postgres container, read by uxcd at launch.
# EDIT ME: uncomment and set a password, then `uxc start postgres`.
# Until you do, the server refuses to initialise and says so in its log
# (`uxc log postgres`) - which is the safe failure for a database.
# Optional: the database and role created on first start (default: postgres).

_comment_caps: The entrypoint initialises the data dir and then runs the server as the 'postgres' user. Listed so the profile also works with --caps minimal.

_registry._comment_shm: Postgres uses shared memory for parallel query workers; raise this for many connections or a large work_mem. It is RAM.
_registry._comment_volumes: EDIT THIS if /srv is not where your data lives. The data dir is a SUBdirectory of the bind, so the env file next to it never ends up inside PGDATA.
_registry._comment_health: Probed inside the container's own network namespace, so 127.0.0.1 is correct both on the host stack and in a shared infra netns.
_registry.notes: Deployed from the 'postgres' recipe. Set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in /srv/postgres/env (0600) BEFORE the first start - without it the server refuses to initialise. Data: /srv/postgres/data (owned by 70). Back up with pg_dump from inside the container: `uxe postgres pg_dump -U postgres <db>`; a file-level copy of a running data dir is not a backup. The image tag is pinned to a major version: a major upgrade needs a dump and restore, never a plain image pull.
